notes.title: Handball Euro Championship Prediction Game
notes.content:
As with every tournament in recent years, we want to enhance the enjoyment by offering a prediction game.

The rules are quite simple: Write your prediction for the final match in the comments. The person who comes closest wins. The correct European champion is prioritized first, followed by the correct runner-up, then the goal difference, and finally, the exact score.

The winner will receive a copy of our brand-new game 'Goalgetter'
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676860
or another Netmin Games title of their choice. Additionally, there is our extensive autograph package featuring signatures from Heiner Brand, Christian Schwarzer, and Ailton.

All predictions must be submitted before the first tournament match.

Have fun and good luck!

notes.title: Our new game 'Goalgetter' is now released!
notes.content:
We believe that fans of the Handball Manager will also find great joy in playing 'goalgetter'.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1676860

'Goalgetter' is a comprehensive football career simulator that allows you to fulfill your dream of becoming a top striker in one of the major European leagues. As a young and talented striker, you can secure your place through intense training or other means, all while managing your personal life decisions, financial investments, and career choices.

notes.title: Handball World Cup Fever
notes.content:
For the Handball World Cup in Poland and Sweden we want to offer something special to our players. Therefore, our game will be sold with a 40% discount for 14 days starting tomorrow.

We are also organising a small competition.

Who can already predict the final?
The competition is open until the end of the preliminary round. Just write your prediction here in the comments - Participant1 vs. Participant2 Goal1:Goals2 - whoever is closest wins and can choose one of our games as a prize, plus receives original autographs from Heiner Brandt, Christian Schwarzer and Ailton. Please enter only once.

notes.title: Kickstarter Campaign for our new game Goalgetter
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the Kickstarter campaign for Goalgetter is out today.
Please support our game, you won't regret it!

We hope to motivate football manager fans with our idea of simulating a football player's career, to support our game. If you are quick, you will receive fantastic special offers as an "early bird".
